name: App Store
summary: Install, update and remove apps from this index, on the car
description: Browse and install NEMESIS packages from the signed kia-apps index. Every download is checked against the index's SHA-256, and the index itself must be signed by a pinned key, newer than the last one seen and not expired. Before installing it says in plain words what a package does. Installs run through a small root helper. The App Store shows up in All Menus with the kia-menu launcher hook installed.
author: hazptr
